interpretation_guard: All candidates use identical source rows, targets, deterministic split and candidate-local sample-order RNG for a given fit seed.
Targets were generated under frozen V1 behavior and therefore this phase cannot reject a symmetry-correct candidate solely for worse V1-target imitation.
Catastrophic numerical failure, inability to represent the paired state, broken legal masking or gross resource infeasibility may block a candidate.
H4 is intentionally excluded from Phase 1 and remains governed by the parent precommit Phase 3 admission rule.
